description: Drives a triangle shaper, then a trapezoid shaper, then a sine shaper from an incoming phasor, to build cyclical modulation shapes; the outputs are not anti-aliased

params.text: Sets the angle of the triangle shaper, sweeping from a rising ramp through a symmetrical triangle to a falling ramp
Attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the Skew CV input before it is added to the Skew knob
Sets the size of the flat top on the trapezoid shaper, and also the pulse width of the Pulse output
Attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the Width CV input before it is added to the Width knob
Sets the steepness of the trapezoid's sloping sides; towards the extreme the sides go vertical and the shape becomes a pulse
Attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the Shape CV input before it is added to the Shape knob
Blends between the raw trapezoid output and a copy of that output put through a sine shaper
Attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the Curve CV input before it is added to the Curve knob
Picks whether all three outputs run 0-10V or -5V to +5V

inputs.text: The phasor driving the shapers, 0-10V; voltages outside that range wrap back into it
Modulates the triangle shaper's angle, added to the Skew knob
Modulates the trapezoid's flat top, added to the Width knob
Modulates the steepness of the trapezoid's sides, added to the Shape knob
Modulates the sine blend, added to the Curve knob

outputs.text: The signal after all three shapers in series
The signal after the triangle shaper alone, before the trapezoid and sine stages
A pulse wave whose width is set by the Width knob, taken from the phasor rather than from the shapers

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
